speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Law (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Law)
text: This serves to make the ownership and control of such entities more transparent and thus reduce opportunities for the misuse of such entities for illicit purposes.

speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
text: My supplementary question is as follows: whether MinLaw would be intending to make the information on beneficial ownership of shell companies which owns properties, accessible by public as well as financial institutions and professionals who act as gatekeepers, so they can do their customer due diligence better.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: I note the underlying concerns in relation to the Member's suggestion.
